subject: Post-call: validate monthly spend range, PO gates & committed options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@nimblestack.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 20:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: validate monthly spend range, PO gates & committed options

Hi Claire — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can prepare a concrete cost/commit proposal for your procurement team.

Recap of what I heard from the call:
- Primary scope: conversational assistant + short-form summarization for support workflows (main traffic: chat + occasional batch summarization).
- Estimated range: ~50M — 120M tokens / month (spiky in month-ends).
- Procurement preference: typically an annual PO for production; pilot may be quarterly.
- Key decision criteria: predictable unit $/1M tokens, ability to cap spend per-month, and audit logs for data residency.

Asks (can you confirm and reply inline):
1) Exact expected monthly token range for pilot vs production (e.g., pilot = 10–30M, production = 60–120M).
2) Target $/1M tokens you’re aiming for (ballpark is fine) — you mentioned $20–30/1M on the call?
3) Procurement PO threshold and timing (what ticket size triggers procurement/legal involvement). Marcus is the procurement contact you mentioned — can you loop him in?

Attached is a very rough MVP cost estimate I ran based on our call (2027-03-20_MVP-cost-estimate.xlsx). If we can get answers to the three asks above by early next week, we’ll draft two committed-band options (pilot and production) and an MOU that maps to your PO cadence.

Proposed next steps:
- Claire confirms numbers & PO gate (by Mon 3/22)
- Redwood sends two committed-band proposals + quick-run SOW (by Wed 3/24)
- Procurement review & PO path (Marcus)

Thanks — happy to jump on another quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
Attachment: 2027-03-20_MVP-cost-estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Claire Ng <claire@nimblestack.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: validate monthly spend range, PO gates & committed options

Hi Aditya — great summary, thanks. Quick answers below and I’ve attached our standard procurement requirements.

1) Traffic split (rough): pilot: 20–35M tokens/mo; production: 55–110M tokens/mo (peak months up to 140M).
2) Target unit economics: we’d like to be around $18–$25 per 1M tokens for committed pricing; if that’s not possible we can entertain $30/1M for a short pilot.
3) Procurement gating: anything over $25k requires formal procurement review and an annual PO (they push for yearly commitments if >$50k). For pilots under $25k we can do a quarterly PO.

Looping Marcus Lee (marcus.lee@nimblestack.com) on procurement items — Marcus, can you confirm their internal timeline for PO approvals and any standard SLAs you require?

Attachment: Nimble_PO_requirements.pdf

—Claire
Head of Data Products, NimbleStack
claire@nimblestack.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: validate monthly spend range, PO gates & committed options

Marissa/Ben — forwarding Claire’s reply. Two immediate asks for us:

1) Pricing ops: can we prepare two committed-band pricing options that match Claire’s bands and target $/1M ranges? Prefer to show (A) pilot band with low entry and modest discount, (B) production band with steeper discount for multi-quarter commit. Include token overage pricing and an option to cap spend.
2) Commercial/legal: Claire notes $25k procurement review threshold and annual PO preference >$50k. We should fast-follow with a short MOU + SOW that maps to a quarterly pilot PO and an option to roll into an annual commit. Any red flags on PO thresholds or required SLAs from legal?

I’ll draft the first-pass commercial bullet points and we can iterate.

Thanks — Aditya

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Ng <claire@nimblestack.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: validate monthly spend range, PO gates & committed options

Hi Claire — thanks for the clarity and for looping Marcus. Based on your ranges and procurement gates, here are two concrete, illustrative options we can put into a short MOU for procurement review. These are draft numbers to get alignment; final pricing will be in the formal commercial.

Option 1 — Pilot (low-friction, 3 months)
- Band: 20–40M tokens / month
- Unit price: $28 per 1M tokens (list) with a committed discount to $24 / 1M for the pilot (effective blended $24/1M)
- Expected spend (at 30M avg): ~$720 / month (est)
- PO path: Quarterly PO acceptable; procurement review if total pilot commitment > $25k

Option 2 — Production (annual commit)
- Band: 60–120M tokens / month
- Unit price: list $28 / 1M with committed discount to $18 / 1M for a 12-month commit at scale
- Expected spend (at 80M avg): ~$1,440 / month (est)
- PO path: Preferred annual PO; procurement prefers commitments > $50k per year

Other notes:
- We’ll include an explicit monthly cap option (you can set a hard cap and we’ll throttle/bill up to the cap).
- Overages billed at a predefined incremental rate; we’ll show an overage ladder in the SOW.
- Data residency and audit logs can be captured in our standard compliance addendum — Marissa, please attach the compliance excerpt.

Next steps proposed:
1) I’ll send a one-page MOU + two-line SOW that maps Option 1 -> pilot PO cadence and Option 2 -> annual PO (by Wed 3/24).
2) Marcus/Procurement: please flag any required SLA minimums or invoice rules so we can bake them into the MOU.
3) If numbers above look directionally correct, we can schedule a 30-min handoff call with procurement the week of 3/29.

If any of the assumptions are off (particularly the $/1M targets), let me know and we’ll iterate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
Attachment: 2027-03-20_MVP-cost-estimate.xlsx (updated)
